edge_sample.source_text: definition BFS layers: Let $s \in V(G)$. The \emph{layers} of breadth-first search from $s$ are the sets \[ L_0 = \{s\}, \qquad L_{k+1} = N^+(L_k) \setminus (L_0 \cup \dots \cup L_k), \] where $N^+(L)$ denotes the set of out-neighbours of the vertices of $L$. The
edge_sample.target_text: lemma Termination: If $L_k \neq \emptyset$ then $k < |V(G)|$. Hence the search from $s$ has exhausted every layer after $|V(G)|$ rounds.
